description: This file defines error handling structures and functions for the operator package, including custom error types, methods for error messages, and constructors for specific HTTP error responses.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: Custom error type encapsulating message, HTTP status code, and underlying error.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message string; includes inner error message if present.

methods.name: JSONResponse
methods.description: Converts the error to a JSON serializable structure suitable for API responses.
